…The wind has risen.

Perhaps it is because we are standing atop the hill.

It blows more fiercely than it did below, its cold biting more sharply into my cheeks.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…It’s a bit windy now.
It must be partly because this place is on top of a hill.
The wind is a bit stronger than normal and carries a sharp chill.

“Shirou. Is your discussion over?”

“…Yeah. The circumstances were driven home harder than I ever wanted.

“The Holy Grail War, what it means to be a Master—all of it.”

“Then—”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Shirou. Is your business here complete?”
“Yeah. I learnt more than enough about the situation I’m in.
About the Holy Grail War, about the Masters, everything.”
“Then”

Saber leans close and searches my face.

…Of course she does.

My choice concerns her as directly as it concerns me.
pages.mirrorMoon:
She comes closer and looks up at me.
…It’s only natural for her to do so.
Her fate is determined by my choice.

pages.en:
“…Yeah. I don't know whether I'm up to it, but I've decided to fight as a Master.

“Sorry you got stuck with an amateur, but can you accept me as your Master, Saber?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…I don’t know if I’m good enough for you, but I’ve decided to fight as a Master.
I’m sorry that I’m only an amateur. Are you still content that I’m your Master?”

pages.ja: 「納得するも何もありません。貴方は初めから私のマスターです。この身は、貴方の剣になると誓ったではないですか」
pages.jaRuby: 「納得するも何もありません。貴方は初めから私のマスターです。この身は、貴方の剣になると誓ったではないですか」
pages.en: “There is nothing to accept. You have been my Master from the beginning. Did I not swear that this body would become your sword?”
pages.mirrorMoon: “It matters not. You are already my Master. I have already sworn to be your sword.”

pages.ja:
思わず、あの時の光景が蘇った。
「

pages.en:
The sight of that moment returns to me.

“—That's right. …Yeah. Hearing you say that helps.”

I let out a quiet breath and turn to face Saber anew.
pages.mirrorMoon:
That scene flashes through my mind.
“You’re right. …Yeah, I’m relieved that you say so.”
I take a deep breath and look at Saber again.

ならせめて、一番初めの挨拶ぐらいはキチンとしておきたかった。

pages.en:
“Then let's shake hands. I'll be counting on you from now on, Saber.”

I hold out my right hand.

I know nothing about the proper relationship between Master and Servant, nor what we ought to do next.

All the more reason to begin with a proper greeting.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Then let’s shake hands. Let’s do our best together, Saber.”
I extend my right hand.
I don’t care what relationship a Master and his servant should have, nor do I know what I should be doing now.
If this is the way things are going to be, I at least want our first greeting to be in style.

With that, Saber lays her right hand in mine.

“Then let me swear once more. So long as the Command Spell remains upon you, this body shall be your sword.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
Saber takes my hand as she says so.
“I shall swear to you once more here. As long as you possess your Command Spell, I shall be your sword.”

pages.ja:
「ああ。よく判らないけど、頼む」
セイバーが大真面目なものだから、こっちもつられて頷いてしまった。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Yeah. I don't really understand it, but I'm counting on you.”

Saber is so solemn that I find myself nodding with equal gravity.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I don’t get the situation too well, but yes, please.”
Saber is really serious, so I nod.

pages.en:
“————Hmm.”

…Now that I look at us calmly, it is a strange sight.

Beneath the winter stars, I am shaking hands with a girl I have only just met, our hands cold as ice, while we exchange words that sound almost like a contract.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Hm.”
…Come to think of it, this is weird.
We’re under the winter night sky.
I’m shaking hands with a girl I just met, and we’re talking like we’re making a contract.

pages.ja: 「仲いいじゃない。さっきまでは話もしなかったのに、大した変わり様ね。なに、セイバーの事は完全に信頼したってワケ？」
pages.jaRuby: 「仲いいじゃない。さっきまでは話もしなかったのに、大した変わり様ね。なに、セイバーの事は完全に信頼したってワケ？」

pages.mirrorMoon: “You two are getting along well. You weren’t even talking before, but things have certainly changed. What, you trust Saber now?”

“What…? No, that isn't—well, I suppose it is.

“I still don't know anything about Saber, but we're going to face this together from now on.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Um… No, that’s not it… Well, I guess you’re right.
I don’t know anything about Saber yet, but I’ll be with her from now on.”

pages.en:
“I see. Then you had better stay on your guard. Now that you've made that decision, we won't show you any mercy.”

“?”

I tilt my head.

For a moment, I cannot understand what she means.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I see. Then you should be on guard. Since you two are in this war, I won’t go easy on you either.”
“?”
I tilt my head in wonder.
For a brief moment, I don’t get what she said.

But you’re one of the Masters now, right? Then I think there’s only one thing to do now.”

“What? You promised not to interfere until I said so, Archer.”

“I know, but we will make no progress like this.
We do not need to find out if our enemy is ready or not. If there are enemies we can defeat easily, we should attack them without holding back.”
“Hey, I know that without you having to tell me.”

“Hey, Tohsaka. The thing about you ‘owing’ me… do you mean what happened back then?”
“Yeah. No matter what the reason may be, you used your Command Spell to stop Saber. So I have to hold back a bit to balance things out.”

“…Balance? You worry about weird things, Tohsaka.”
“I know. I understand this is just flab on my mind. But I can’t help it. I hate owing people.”
She turns away.

“But this is a limited-time offer. Tomorrow, I won't show you the least mercy, so you had better spend the night forming a strategy with Saber.”

“…Hmm. So your generosity expires at the end of today?”

pages.mirrorMoon:

“……”
I nod to Saber and follow Tohsaka.

pages.ja:

pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
The three of us descend the hill.

Perhaps because Tohsaka walks so far ahead, we reach the bottom without exchanging a word of consequence.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The three of us descend the hill together.
It might be because Tohsaka is walking ahead, but we go down the hill with few words.

One way follows the main avenue toward Shinto Station. The other leads toward the great bridge back to Miyama.

“Tohsaka? Why did you stop? The bridge is that way if we're going home.”

“No. Sorry, but you'll have to go the rest of the way alone.

“I was so preoccupied with you that I forgot I have things to do too. Since I'm already in Shinto, I may as well search for something before I leave.”

“No. I’m sorry, but go home by yourself.
I forgot since I’ve been concerned with you, but I’m busy. I’m already in Shinto, so I’ll go look while I’m here.”

“This is where we part. I've met my obligation, and staying together any longer would only complicate matters. We need to make a clean break and become enemies tomorrow.”

Why does she possess so much excess that runs contrary to everything a mage should be?

Why does she have this part of her that’s unlike a magus?

She just supported me, understanding the situation I’m in, and acted fairly.

聡明な彼女の事だから、それは判りきっている筈。

From Rin Tohsaka's perspective, everything she did tonight was unnecessary.

*Staying together any longer would only complicate matters.*

If she could say that, she should never have accompanied me in the first place.

She is intelligent enough to have known that from the start.

Yet without once weighing profit against loss, Rin Tohsaka took Shirou Emiya by the hand.

For Tohsaka, everything that happened tonight is unnecessary.
‘It would be troublesome if we stay together any longer.’
If she’s going to say something like that, she should have left us alone from the beginning.
Tohsaka’s smart, so she should know that all too well.
But still, she set aside all thoughts of loss or gain and helped me out.

いやもう、こんなのほとんどサギだと思う。

…The Tohsaka before me is utterly different from the one I see at school.

To put it mildly, her personality is abrasive. She is prickly and unapproachable, and the difference is so extreme that I want to ask what on earth all that behavior at school is supposed to be.

Honestly, it is practically fraud.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The Tohsaka in front of me is so different from the one at school.
Even when I put it nicely, she’s sour, cranky, unapproachable, and so different that I want to scream.
Man, it feels almost like a fraud.

The shadow is long and grotesque, like a devil in a picture book.
In this gloomy town of shadow-pictures stands a figure that should not be there.

That thing is not human.

Then it must be one of the beings called Servants, the same as Saber and the others.

“Good evening, big brother. This is the second time we've met like this.”

The girl speaks with a smile.

Her innocence sends a chill down my spine.

The girl and the grotesque thing behind her are so terribly mismatched that the sight feels like a nightmare.

“————”

No. A chill is far too mild.

Not only my body but my very consciousness has frozen solid.

That thing is a monster.

Our eyes have not even met, yet its mere existence leaves me unable to move—

The unseen knight answers.

「こっちは三人よ。凌ぐだけならなんとでもなるわ」
それに頷いたのか。
遠坂の背後に控えていた気配は、一瞬にして何処かに消失した。

pages.en:
“Understood. But what of your defense? You cannot stop that creature's charge, Rin.”

“There are three of us here. If all we need to do is hold out, we'll find a way.”

Perhaps he nods.

The presence stationed behind Tohsaka vanishes somewhere in an instant.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Understood. But what about your defense? You cannot defend against his charge.”
“There are three of us. We can manage if all we need to do is defend.”
He must have nodded to her words.
The presence behind Tohsaka vanishes instantly.

pages.en:
“—Emiya. Whether you run or fight is your choice.

“…But if you can, find some way to escape.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Emiya-kun. You can choose whether to run or fight.
…But if you can, try to run away.”

pages.ja:
「相談は済んだ？ なら、始めちゃっていい？」
軽やかな笑い声。
少女は行儀良く、この場に不釣り合いなお辞儀をした。
pages.jaRuby:
「相談は済んだ？ なら、始めちゃっていい？」
軽やかな笑い声。

pages.en:
“Finished with your little conference? Then may we begin?”

A light, delighted laugh.

The girl gives a prim curtsy grotesquely out of place in these surroundings.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Are you done? Can I start now?”
The girl laughs playfully.
She curtsies in a manner quite out of place in such a situation.

イリヤスフィール・フォン・アインツベルンって言えばわかるでしょ？」
「アインツベルン
」

pages.en:
“It's nice to meet you, Rin. I'm Illya.

“Illyasviel von Einzbern. Surely that name means something to you?”

“Einzbern—”

Tohsaka's body trembles faintly. Perhaps she recognizes the name.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Nice to meet you, Rin. I am Illya.
You should figure it out if I make that Illyasviel von Einzbern.”
“Einzbern”
Tohsaka’s body stiffens, apparently recognizing that name.

pages.ja:
そんな遠坂の反応が気に入ったのか、少女は嬉しそうに笑みをこぼし、
「
じゃあ殺すね。やっちゃえ、バーサーカー」
歌うように、背後の異形に命令した。

pages.en:
Apparently pleased by Tohsaka's reaction, the girl smiles happily.

“—Then I'll kill you now. Get them, Berserker.”

In a singsong voice, she gives the grotesque figure behind her its command.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Perhaps she liked Tohsaka’s reaction, as the girl smiles happily. And then…
“Then I’ll kill you now. Go ahead, Berserker.”
…She orders the strange shape behind her, as if she’s singing.
